# Project report chapters, as built (R3-20)

Chapters for the near-final project report, written from build `{{build.tag}}`. They describe what exists, with file names, so a reader can
check every statement. The department's formatting, front matter, literature survey and references are added later by the team.

| Chapter | File |
|---|---|
| 1. System design | `01_system_design.md` |
| 2. Implementation, module by module | `02_implementation.md` |
| 3. Testing and validation | `03_testing_validation.md` |
| 4. Results and discussion | `04_results_discussion.md` |
| 5. Limitations | `05_limitations.md` |
| 6. Future work (Capstone 2) | `06_future_work.md` |

Diagrams are in `docs/diagrams/` (Mermaid source, SVG and PNG). Figures are in `reports/figures/`. Numbers are in `reports/FINAL_NUMBERS.md`.
Before submission the team runs the plagiarism check (R3-22) on the final text.
